challenge.method: Compare the right-hand article p. 38 on PDF p. 19 with the contents heading, context on the adjoining NoteTaker page, and the Smalltalk-80 Blue Book preface. Test whether the evidence signifies only a platform delivery or documents an iteration of the Smalltalk language.

The scoped edition-of relation is supported. Neither the chronology nor the relationship answers compatibility or sole-authorship questions.
